designationHistory.indexText: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service established Clarence Cannon National Wildlife Refuge by purchasing land with migratory bird hunting stamp funds.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Act of 1929; Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approval (purchase with Duck Stamp funds)

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Clarence Cannon National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, Management Plan, Part 3 : Forestry Chapter : Annada District, Mark Twain National Wildlife Refuge : Clarence Cannon National Wildlife Refuge, Delair Division, Gardner Division (ServCat 4830): "Fish and Wildlife Service purchased the Clarence Cannon Refuge ... in 1964"

review.note: Purchased 1964 (Mark Twain NWR management plan). Exact date not found.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Clarence Cannon National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1964 with funds from the purchase of migratory waterfowl stamps.
